title: " Implémentation de la fonction henze_gof"
author: "TITO A. Rytrace"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: pdf_document
---

```{r}
henze_gof <- function(x, t, a = 1, boot = 500, alpha = 0.05, dt_eq = NULL) {
  
  if (!require(gofgamma)) {
    install.packages("gofgamma")
    library(gofgamma)
  }
  
  gamma_bridge <- function(t, x, a, dt_eq) {
    
    if(any(diff(t) <= 0)) stop("Les temps doivent être strictement croissants")
    if(a <= 0) stop("a doit être positif")
    
    Np <- floor(max(t) / dt_eq)
    t_eq <- seq(dt_eq, Np * dt_eq, by = dt_eq)
    x_eq <- numeric(Np)
    
    for (i in 1:Np) {
      
      ti <- t_eq[i]
      
      sup_i <- which(t >= ti)[1]
      t_sup <- t[sup_i]
      x_sup <- x[sup_i]
      
      if (sup_i == 1) {
        t_inf <- 0
        x_inf <- 0
      } else {
        t_inf_candidate <- t[sup_i - 1]
        
        if (t_inf_candidate > (i - 1) * dt_eq) {
          t_inf <- t_inf_candidate
          x_inf <- x[sup_i - 1]
        } else {
          t_inf <- (i - 1) * dt_eq
          x_inf <- if (i > 1) x_eq[i - 1] else 0
        }
      }
      
      alpha1 <- a * max(ti - t_inf, 1e-10)
      alpha2 <- a * max(t_sup - ti, 1e-10)
      
      if (alpha1 <= 0 || alpha2 <= 0) {
        stop(paste("Paramètres bêta non positifs:", alpha1, alpha2))
      }
      
      y <- rbeta(1, alpha1, alpha2)
      x_eq[i] <- x_inf + (x_sup - x_inf) * y
    }
    
    return(data.frame(time = t_eq, value = x_eq))
  }
  
  tri_sample <- function(dt, dx, dt_eq) {
    
    N <- length(dt)
    
    dt_c <- dt
    dx_c <- dx
    
    dt_s <- numeric(N)
    dx_s <- numeric(N)
    
    max_i <- which.max(dt_c)
    dt_s[1] <- dt_c[max_i]
    dx_s[1] <- dx_c[max_i]
    
    dt_c <- dt_c[-max_i]
    dx_c <- dx_c[-max_i]
    
    for (i in 2:N) {
      
      cum_time <- sum(dt_s[1:(i - 1)])
      diffs <- (cum_time + dt_c) - i * dt_eq
      
      valid <- which(diffs >= 0)
      
      if (length(valid) > 0) {
        choix <- valid[which.min(diffs[valid])]
      } else {
        choix <- which.max(diffs)
      }
      
      dt_s[i] <- dt_c[choix]
      dx_s[i] <- dx_c[choix]
      
      dt_c <- dt_c[-choix]
      dx_c <- dx_c[-choix]
    }
    
    return(list(dt = dt_s, dx = dx_s))
  }
  
  estimer_a <- function(t, x) {
    
    dt <- diff(t)
    dx <- diff(x)
    
    m_hat <- sum(dx) / sum(dt)
    n_hat <- sum((dx - m_hat * dt)^2) /
             (sum(dt) - sum(dt^2) / sum(dt))
    
    return(m_hat^2 / n_hat)
  }
  
  dt <- diff(t)
  dx <- diff(x)
  
  # Vérifier si les temps sont réguliers
  tol <- 1e-8
  if (all(abs(dt - dt[1]) < tol)) {
    # Cas régulier : on utilise directement les incréments
    resultat <- test.HME1(dx, a = a, boot = boot, alpha = alpha)
  } else {
    # Cas irrégulier : on régularise
    if(is.null(dt_eq)) dt_eq <- max(t)/length(dt)
    
    tri <- tri_sample(dt, dx, dt_eq)
    t_tri <- c(0, cumsum(tri$dt))
    x_tri <- c(0, cumsum(tri$dx))
    
    a_ref <- estimer_a(t_tri, x_tri)
    
    interp <- gamma_bridge(t_tri, x_tri, a_ref, dt_eq)
    dx_eq <- diff(c(0, interp$value))
    
    resultat <- test.HME1(dx_eq, a = a, boot = boot, alpha = alpha)
  }
  
  return(resultat)
}
```

```{r}
# Application 

# Cas régulier : t est régulier
t_reg <- seq(0, 100, by = 1)
x_reg <- cumsum(rgamma(100, shape = 2, rate = 1))
henze_gof(x = x_reg, t = t_reg)

# Cas irrégulier : t est irrégulier
t_irr <- cumsum(runif(100, 0.5, 1.5))
x_irr <- cumsum(rgamma(100, shape = 2 * diff(c(0, t_irr)), rate = 1))
henze_gof(x = x_irr, t = t_irr)
```
